tool: Codex built-in image generation plus deterministic Pillow composition
model: OpenAI built-in image model (model identifier not exposed)
style: Owner-approved Rain Book 1 family: calm luminous paper-cut watercolour and gouache science storybook on cream paper; rain-blue, leaf-green and sunny-yellow; scientifically clear and non-frightening.

images.name: cover
images.prompt: Exact recurring cast and Papillon Vanilla on a safe broad crest viewpoint of a grand curved dam; quiet reservoir, faint side spillway and calm downstream river; title space; no text or danger.

images.name: wall-and-lake
images.prompt: Object-only strict side cutaway: broad high reservoir left, thick wall founded on bedrock, narrow lower downstream river right and exactly one distant boat; no leak, overtopping or label boxes.
images.composition_method: build-rain-book7-art.py places reservoir, dam and downstream-river labels in fixed positions.

images.name: where-water-comes-from
images.prompt: Aerial catchment bowl with two gentle rain clouds and many downhill streams and arrows converging on the low reservoir behind one dam.
images.composition_method: build-rain-book7-art.py draws one fixed gold catchment-ridge line and label.

images.name: two-numbers
images.attempt: generated attempt 1 plus accepted deterministic relabel attempt 2
images.prompt: Two panels: reservoir level and exactly three bottle symbols for stored volume; one stopwatch, one translucent cube and one downstream arrow for volume passing per second.
images.composition_method: build-rain-book7-art.py replaces the complete lower-left card and places exact STORED WATER/million m³ text while preserving the FLOW/m³ each second card.

images.name: store-and-release
images.prompt: Same dam twice: rainy season larger inflow and rising level; dry season larger release and falling level; calm downstream farm, homes/waterworks and power uses.
images.composition_method: build-rain-book7-art.py places fixed rainy/dry season captions.

images.name: making-room
images.prompt: Before/after planned release: reservoir lower on right with room for forecast rain; exactly three adult operators; same downstream gauge slightly higher on right yet in-bank.
images.composition_method: build-rain-book7-art.py places fixed TODAY 80% and AFTER 65% labels.

images.name: spillway
images.prompt: Strict cutaway with separate open-channel abutment spillway, normal level below lip, faint higher line, controlled chute and broad dissipating pool; no wall overtopping.
images.composition_method: build-rain-book7-art.py places dam wall, spillway and splash pool labels.

images.name: upstream-downstream
images.attempt: 2 plus clean deterministic recomposite after controller rejection
images.prompt: Arrow-free aerial view with exactly two floating houses, one pier and two boats upstream; calm downstream river, farms, village and waterworks; normal release only.
images.composition_method: build-rain-book7-art.py adds only the fixed upstream/downstream labels; the rejected gold relationship symbol was removed completely.

images.name: not-all-dams
images.prompt: Tall curved storage dam, huge reservoir and powerhouse over a low long gated diversion barrage on a broad brown river splitting into exactly two irrigation canals.
images.composition_method: build-rain-book7-art.py places the STORAGE DAM and DIVERSION BARRAGE headers.

images.name: dams-map
images.attempt: generated plate 1 rejected; coarse deterministic composite rejected; Natural Earth 1:10m composite plus accepted subtitle passed
images.prompt: Text-free soft-atlas green/blue/cream Thailand base texture with faint rivers and broad margins; no markers, labels or legend from the model.
images.composition_method: build-rain-book7-art.py clips the generated texture to the Natural Earth 1:10m Thailand land mask, shows neighbouring countries faintly, clips Natural Earth 1:10m rivers to that same mask, projects all 12 source lat/lon points, numbers them in thematic order, and renders the accurate 12 dams and barrages subtitle, English list and distinct storage/barrage legend.
images.note_2026_10_06: header band redrawn: title no longer clipped by the subtitle relabel patch (owner)
images.note_2026_10_06_rivers: list rows now read "<river> · <province>" (owner: add dam <-> river, text only)

images.name: closing
images.prompt: Exact cover cast and Papillon Vanilla at a safe golden-hour dam viewpoint; calm reservoir, downstream river across green plain, and one friendly ranger waving goodbye.
